name: Silverlake Ramen Classic Shoyu Ramen with Chashu Pork (Riverton)
brandOrRestaurant: Silverlake Ramen (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
whyItWorks: Clear, soy-sauce-based chicken and fish broth is far lighter and lower in emulsified lard than creamy tonkotsu broths. Served with tender wheat noodles and a slice of braised pork belly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Shoyu ramen with NO green onions and NO bean sprouts. Ask for noodles cooked soft and remove excess fat from the pork slice.
